title: CosyVoice 3, text rules off

tricks: Breath, laugh, cough and sigh use the tokenizer's own tags
Giggle shares the laughter tag because there is no softer one
Um is written out as a word
The RL-tuned language model weights (llm.rl.pt) replace the stock ones
The built-in text clean-up is off so digits and dollar amounts reach the model as written

why: CosyVoice 3 with its native sound tags and the text clean-up off, because the clean-up misreads prices and the repeated phone number.
